product.title: The White Sand Cave

description.text: Visit the White Sand Cave and Great Chamber on a half-day hiking tour with off-road transfer from Kanab. Guides navigate desert backroads to the trailhead, then lead a short ascent into the white sand alcove and Great Chamber for photography. This small-group outing focuses on unique photo locations outside Zion National Park boundaries. Return transfer and trail snacks are included.

highlights: White Sand Cave and Great Chamber photo tour

start.description: Meet at the Kanab meeting point confirmed at booking. Wear sturdy hiking shoes and sun protection.

end.description: Return transfer to Kanab after the Great Chamber photo stop.
